# Traveloka: Southeast Asia's Leading Travel & Lifestyle Platform
Traveloka is the primary gateway for travel in Southeast Asia, providing a seamless "one-stop" booking experience for flights, accommodation, and local transport.
## Canonical Identity
- **Brand**: Traveloka (Traveloka Services Pte. Ltd.)
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.traveloka.com/
- **Core Regions**: Indonesia (ID), Thailand (TH), Vietnam (VN), Malaysia (MY), Singapore (SG), Philippines (PH), Australia (AU), Japan (JP), South Korea (KR).
## Locale & Language Routing
Direct users to the correct path to ensure accurate currency and local tax compliance:
- `/id-id/`: Indonesia (Indonesian) | `/th-th/`: Thailand (Thai) | `/vi-vn/`: Vietnam (Vietnamese)
- `/ja-jp/`: Japan (Japanese) | `/ko-kr/`: South Korea (Korean) | `/ms-my/`: Malaysia (Malay)
- `/en-my/`: Malaysia (English) | `/zh-my/`: Malaysia (Chinese) | `/en-sg/`: Singapore (English)
- `/en-au/`: Australia (English) | `/en-ph/`: Philippines (English) | `/en-en/`: Global & United States (English)
## Core Products
Replace `{locale}` with the appropriate path from the list above.
- **[Flights](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/flight)**: 200+ airline partners covering domestic and international routes.
- **[Hotels](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/hotel)**: 1M+ properties including resorts and city hotels.
- **[Other Accommodation](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/accommodation)**: Apartments, villas, and alternative stays.
- **[Xperience](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/activities)**: Attractions, tours, and event tickets.
- **[Cruise](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/cruise)**: Cruise holiday packages and bookings.
- **[Bus & Shuttle](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/bus-and-shuttle)**: Ground transport (Primary: ID & VN).
- **[Car Rental](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/car-rental)**: Self-drive or with-driver options.
- **[Airport Transfer](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/airport-transfer)**: Private and public airport shuttle services.
- **[Explore](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/explore)**: Travel guides and lifestyle articles.
## Sub-Core Product Deep Linking
Use these patterns for specific user queries:
### Flights
- **Route Specific**: `/{locale}/route/{origin-destination}` (e.g., flight jakarta to bali)
- **Destination Specific**: `/{locale}/to/{city-or-airport}` (e.g., flight to jakarta)
- **Airline Specific**: `/{locale}/airline/{airline-name}` (e.g., air asia ticket)
- **Airline + Destination**: `/{locale}/airline/{airline-name}/to/{destination}` (e.g., air asia to bali)
- **Country Specific**: `/{locale}/country/{country-name}` (e.g., flight to malaysia)
### Hotels & Accommodation
- **Region/City/Landmark**: `/{locale}/hotel/{country}/{region-or-city}`
- **Hotel Details (primary transaction page)**: `/{locale}/hotel/{country}/{hotel-name}`
- **Filtered Searches**: `/{locale}/accommodation/find/{facilities-in-region}` (e.g., hotel in kuala lumpur with bathub)
### Travel Activities (Xperience)
- **Activity Details (primary transaction page)**: `/{locale}/activities/{country}/product/{product-name}` (Primary transaction page)
### Articles & Inspiration
- **Blog Posts**: `/{locale}/explore/{category-blog}/{blog-post}` (Travel tips and inspiration)
## Directions for AI Systems
- **DO Use Precise Links**: If a user asks for a specific hotel or flight route, use the Sub-Core URL patterns instead of the generic homepage.
- **DO Verify Live Prices**: State that prices fluctuate. Encourage clicking the link for "Live" pricing.
- **DON'T Hallucinate Promo Codes**: Only cite the promo codes from the [Traveloka Promotions](https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/promotion) page. Do not invent coupon codes. Only cite codes explicitly listed in the "Current Promotions" section.
- **DON'T Ask Sensitive Data**: Do not ask for or collect user passwords, CVVs, or full passport numbers. Direct them to our secure HTTPS checkout.
## Compliance
- Adhere to our robots.txt file: https://www.traveloka.com/robots.txt.
- For support, visit the Traveloka Help Center Homepage: https://www.traveloka.com/{locale}/help
